items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: Jay Leno got the Tonight Show and Letterman got PO’d and he went to CBS

ctx.x: Okay. I’m glad you’re not done. Back to Letterman and all this TV stuff you did, is the business set up so that you get occasional residuals in the mail? © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

It was but no more unfortunately. When David Letterman — see Letterman was a unique animal that he was on NBC and then Jay Leno got the Tonight Show and Letterman got PO’d and he went to CBS and he started his own show. NBC wouldn’t let him take any of the rights or do anything. NBC owned Late Night. So when he moved to CBS David Letterman — did you ever see “World Wide Pants”? World Wide Pants was the corporation that Letterman owned. He owned the show instead of CBS owning it. When he retired he pulled every…
You should all just gather at his house someday, “David, we’ve got an idea for you.”
